messages.subject: Adding line to scatter plot
parts:
Hi,

I drew a scatter plot of ~800 points and would like to add a line of the average of ever 20 points (by sliding window). In this case the vector of average is 19 shorter than the original data. Anybody know how to add such "average" line?

Many thanks!

messages.author: 942ffec526d6a312
messages.subject: Re: Adding line to scatter plot
parts:
Hi,

> I drew a scatter plot of ~800 points and would like to add a line of the
> average of ever 20 points (by sliding window). In this case the vector
> of average is 19 shorter than the original data. Anybody know how to add
> such "average" line?

It would be easier to help with a reproducible example showing where
you've got to and giving some data. In that case I would have actually
had a go at doing/testing it rather than just saying 'I think this needs
to be done'.

I think you need to put your rolling mean (y-values) into a second
data.frame (given that there are fewer means than observations), along
with a rolling mean of the x-values corresponding to the same window,
then use geom_line to plot it.

Regards,
Ron.
